items.name: Veyraki
items.description:
The Veyraki are an exceptionally rare humanoid species whose existence is largely unknown to the inhabitants of Ishtar. Although physically similar to humans, they possess a long, fur-covered prehensile tail, remarkable physical endurance, and an extraordinary metabolism.

Veyraki retain their youthful appearance and physical capabilities for considerably longer than most humanoid species. A Veyraki in their fifties may appear physically indistinguishable from one in their twenties.

Little is known about their origins or original homeland. However, their unusual connection to a rare celestial phenomenon known as the Ember Moon suggests that their biology holds secrets even they may not fully understand.

Veyraki Traits

Creature Type: Humanoid
Size: Medium
Speed: 30 feet

Lifespan: Veyraki can live for approximately 200 years. They reach physical maturity at around 20 years of age and retain their youthful appearance until approximately 70 years of age, after which visible physical aging gradually begins.

As a Veyraki, you have the following special traits.

Natural Athleticism. You gain proficiency in the Athletics or Acrobatics skill (your choice).

Prehensile Tail. You can use your tail to pick up or hold objects weighing no more than 10 pounds, open or close doors and containers, or perform similarly simple tasks. Your tail can't wield weapons or shields, activate magic items, perform the Somatic components of spells, or grant you additional attacks or actions.

Unbroken Spirit. When you take damage that leaves you Bloodied without reducing you to 0 Hit Points, you can gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1). No action is required. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Voracious Metabolism. By spending 10 minutes consuming 10 Rations, you can reduce your Exhaustion level by 1. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Sensitive Tail. A creature that knows about your tail's vulnerability can specifically attempt to Grapple it if your tail is exposed. If the attempt succeeds, you have the Restrained condition instead of the Grappled condition until you escape or the creature releases your tail.

You can wrap your tail securely around your waist or torso to protect it. While secured in this way, your tail can't be targeted separately, but you can't use your Prehensile Tail trait.

Ember Moon. Upon reaching physical maturity, your body becomes susceptible to the influence of the Ember Moon. Exposure to this rare celestial phenomenon can trigger an extraordinary physical transformation. The nature, duration, and consequences of this transformation are determined by the DM. You can't willingly activate this transformation through this trait.
